LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_AccelerateHealing.label: accelerate healing
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_AccelerateHealing.descript: Hasten the natural healing processes of an injured creature.
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_BodyBooster.label: energise
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_BodyBooster.description: Energise a friendly target, increasing their movement and unskilled labour speed.
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_BrainBooster.label: cognition enhancement
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_BrainBooster.description: Boost the mental faculties of a friendly target so that they complete research tasks more quickly.
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_Fortitude.label: fortitude
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_Fortitude.description: Fortify a target with psychic energy, allowing them to more easily withstand incoming damage.
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_MindLink.label: mind link
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_MindLink.description: Form a psychic link between caster and target. Some of the skill experience gained by one linked member will be shared with the other. The link lasts for some time, but will break if the two move far apart.
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_Precognition.label: precognition
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_Precognition.description: The caster can see events unfold moments before they occur, allowing them to predict the movements of their enemies.
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_PsyLance.label: psychic lance
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_PsyLance.description: Sear an enemy's mind with spike of pure psychic energy. Can damage electronic brains.
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_Pyrokinesis.label: pyrokinesis
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_Pyrokinesis.description: Start a small fire with burst of psychic energy. Does not require line of sight to the target location.
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_SenseThoughts.label: sense thoughts
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_SenseThoughts.description: Use telepathy to gain an advantage in social situations.
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_SoothingThoughts.label: soothe mind
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_SoothingThoughts.descripti: Snap someone out of a mental break and help them forget their worries for a while.
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_Stasis.label: stasis
LanguageData.ExtraPsycasts_Stasis.description: Send a friendly target into a comatose state, drastically reducing their need for basic necessities and steming bleeding.
